_note: Recommended action per line x direction x cause. cause: cost (the rupee amount moved) | revenue (amount normal, revenue moved) | unknown (no baseline yet).

above.cost: Review shift roster, overtime and temp-labour bookings for the day
above.revenue: Manpower spend was normal; volume was low. Flex staffing to forecast volume
above.unknown: Review shift roster, overtime and temp-labour bookings

below.any: Check that all manpower (incl. contract labour) was booked for the day

above.cost: Check packaging material issued vs orders shipped (wastage, wrong carton sizes)
above.revenue: Packaging use tracked volume; low revenue per order. Check order mix
above.unknown: Check packaging material issued vs orders shipped

above.cost: Check DG-set running hours / power outage and fuel bills
above.revenue: Power cost was normal; revenue was low
above.unknown: Check DG-set hours and fuel bills

below.any: Power & fuel looks under-booked. Confirm the electricity/diesel entry

above.cost: Rent amount changed. Check rent allocation / duplicate booking
above.revenue: Rent is fixed; the breach is a low-revenue effect. Focus on volume
above.unknown: Check rent allocation for the day

below.any: Rent looks under-allocated. Confirm the daily rent accrual

above.cost: Review equipment rentals: idle MHE, extra hires, off-hire missed
above.revenue: Equipment cost was normal; revenue was low

below.any: Confirm equipment rental accrual was booked

above.cost: Audit overhead bills booked for the day (one-off or misposted expense?)
above.revenue: Overheads were normal; revenue was low
above.unknown: Audit overhead bills for the day

_day.RED: Cost audit today: start with the top contributors above
_day.RED_REVENUE: Costs were normal; revenue fell. Check volumes/billing for the day before cutting costs
_day.BLUE: Do not report this margin yet. Confirm all cost invoices for the day are booked
_day.CM1: Review direct costs (manpower and packaging) against volume
_day.LINE_ONLY: Margins held, but a line drifted. Review the flagged line before it compounds
